principles.missingness: Preserve source nulls and never infer an SDMX observation-status code unless the source provides evidence for that status.
principles.units: Attach explicit unit semantics; do not infer mathematical range solely from the unit symbol or column-name suffix.
principles.keys: Model semantic dimensions separately from physical key normalization. Derived key helpers must not overwrite the source dimension.
principles.quality: Thresholds are use-case-specific executable contract policy; the external quality standard owns the measurement model, not the threshold value.

document_subtype.sourceMeaning: Applicable only when document_type is posted-content; null is retained for other document types.
document_subtype.observationStatusPolicy: Do not assign CL_OBS_STATUS; this is source-defined dimension applicability, not an observation-value status.

se4all-energy.observationStatusPolicy: Source NA values are preserved as null. No SDMX CL_OBS_STATUS code is invented because the source does not provide one.

validity.basis: Source definition is percentage of urban population with access; tolerance is pilot fitness-for-use policy for source rounding.
Source definition is percentage of total population with electricity access; tolerance is pilot fitness-for-use policy for source rounding.
Source definition is renewable-energy share of TFEC.
Source definition is share of renewable capacity in total capacity.
No universal upper bound is inferred from percent unit alone.
No universal upper bound is inferred from percent unit alone; source values above 100 are preserved.
